component.name: Velox
component.summary: Run your containers and virtual machines
Kör dina containrar och virtuella maskiner

description.p: Velox shows the containers of the computer's Docker Engine or Podman, grouped by Compose project, and starts and stops them. It follows the engine live.
Velox also makes and runs virtual machines on QEMU from Debian, Ubuntu and Fedora cloud images, and follows them live too.
Velox never installs or configures anything. When an engine or QEMU is missing, it shows the steps to set it up.
